::: {.callout-note}
## 1990 manual bibliographically confirmed — copy sought; 1994 identity remains INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE
A 1990 ECPM skill-development manual with five modules is independently cited in a public 1990s bibliography inspected for this catalogue. No copy of that manual was recovered. A possible 1994 training revision, named in [jordanforge-infrastructure issue 10](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/jordanforge-infrastructure/issues/10) and in the later research brief as associated with Emma Van der Klift, was **not** found. Van der Klift’s inspected 1994 publication is a different work ([Hell-Bent on Helping](1994-van-der-klift-hell-bent.qmd)). Experiment 001’s bounded search classified the 1990-versus-1994 identity question as **INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE** — not a contradiction between two inspected bibliographic records.
:::

## Identification

| Element | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Title as cited independently | “Enhanced Consumer Participation Model: Skill Development Manual for Consumers of Home Support Services” — [Roeher Institute with Brian Salisbury](1990s-roeher-if-bibliography.qmd) |
| Creator as cited independently | “BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society” (same bibliography) |
| Date as cited independently | 1990 (same bibliography) |
| Physical description as cited independently | “A training manual that includes 5 modules intended to empower consumers to act as effective employers (52 pages plus appendices)” |
| Later organizational attribution | [IFRC “Our Team”](ifrc-our-team.qmd) describes ECPM as “the individual funding project” that preceded CSIL, naming Joseph Theriault with Paul Gauthier. No manual title or date. |
| Pre-CSIL list in later slides | [Gauthier 2014](2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd) lists “ECPM Enhanced Consumer Participation Model” as a pre-CSIL step, without a citation. |
| 1994 training revision | Named in the commissioning issue and research brief. Not found in Roeher, IFRC slides, Internet Archive, or Van der Klift’s public pages. |
| Emma Van der Klift / Vancouver Health Department | Named in the commissioning issue / research brief. The inspected 1994 Van der Klift & Kunc chapter does not mention ECPM or those agencies. |
| VCH “institutional survival” | Current [VCH CSIL service page](vch-csil-service-page.qmd) does **not** use the ECPM name. |

This record may still represent more than one publication. It is kept as a single wanted item until distinct editions can be identified.

## What this pass actually inspected

Inspected: Roeher / Salisbury bibliography PDF; IFRC Our Team; Gauthier 2014 slides; Van der Klift & Kunc 1994 chapter (Broadreach republication); current VCH CSIL page; Internet Archive advanced search for the quoted phrase (zero items, 20 September 2026).

Not inspected: the 1990 manual; any 1994 revision; a library catalogue holding record.

## Annotation

Public bibliographic evidence supports treating a 1990 *Skill Development Manual* (five modules; 52 pages plus appendices; BC Rehab & GVHSS) as a real, cited publication. The archive has not seen the text. Later IFRC pages treat ECPM as a named precursor project; that is later institutional history, not a formal predecessor declaration in a 1990s instrument. The 1990 versus 1994 date question remains **INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE** (Experiment 001 conclusion used as research input). ECPM as a formal predecessor to CSIL remains an **interpretation** until a contemporaneous instrument says so. See the [ECPM chapter](../history/ecpm.qmd).

## Open questions

- How many manuals or editions exist.
- Whether a 1994 item is a revision, a training manual, or a conflicting citation of the 1990 work.
- Title-page authorship, including any role for Emma Van der Klift, GVHSS, or Vancouver Health Department.
- Relationship to [*Keys on Freedom*](wanted-keys-on-freedom.qmd).
- Whether any historical VCH / Vancouver Health Department file still uses the ECPM name.
